name: Poverty Wild Oat Grass
desc: Poverty Wild Oat Grass (Danthonia spicata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Danthonia spicata is a species of grass known by the common name poverty oatgrass, or simply poverty grass. It is native to North America, where it is widespread and common in many areas.
